summary: Tested all 4 bugs (BUG-154/155/156/157) from CR-059 Phase 2. All 4 bugs verified as FIXED. Regression save flow partially tested — form works correctly but backend returned 'Insufficient Cash Draw balance' (account-level restriction in preprod, not a frontend bug). BUG-154 'with unit price' scenario is N/A — no items have unitPriceAmount set in this account.

minor.issue: Backend returns 'Insufficient Cash Draw balance. Available balance: 0' when saving with Cash Draw. This is a preprod account limitation, not a code bug. Save with other payment methods (Cash, UPI etc.) should work.

action_items: For regression testing: test save with 'Cash' payment method instead of 'Cash Draw' since preprod has 0 Cash Draw balance
BUG-154 'with unit price' scenario: N/A — no items have unitPriceAmount set in cafe103 account. If E1 wants this tested, add a test item with unit price via Bulk Edit
critical_code_review_comments: BUG-156 default payment 'Cash Draw' in EMPTY_LINE works correctly — value='Cash Draw' is visible after paymentMethods load from API (not during initial render when options list is empty). This is a non-issue since the select correctly shows Cash Draw once options load.
BUG-154 Qty/Unit hidden via conditional {line.unitPrice != null && line.unitPrice > 0} works correctly. Amount readOnly and cursor:not-allowed applied when unitPrice > 0.
BUG-155 Category shown only for isCustomItem=true. handleItemSelect correctly sets isCustomItem based on item.id presence. Category placeholder 'Category (optional)' correct.
BUG-157 w-72 (288px) left panel confirmed. CategoryRow has minHeight:52px and font-weight:600 (semibold) — all correct.
seed_data_creation: No new test data created. Existing entry from iteration_1 (10000 item, ₹500, Cash) remains on 07/06/2026.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All BUG-154/155/156/157 verified fixed. Cash Draw balance is 0 in preprod — use Cash or UPI for regression save tests. No items have unitPriceAmount set — BUG-154 unit-price path untestable without creating test data in Bulk Edit. Navigation: login → wait for /loading to complete → navigate directly to /expenses or /expense-setup.

BUG-156.description: Default payment method is 'Cash Draw' — confirmed via select.value = 'Cash Draw' after paymentMethods API loads (10 options). Screenshot shows 'Cash Draw' pre-selected in the Payment dropdown.

BUG-154_no_unit_price.description: Qty and Unit fields are NOT in the DOM when no item selected or item has no unitPriceAmount. Amount field is readOnly=false, background=white, cursor=text (editable).

BUG-154_with_unit_price.description: No items in cafe103 account have unitPriceAmount set (all show '—' in Unit Price column). Cannot test auto-calc path without test data.

BUG-155_free_text.description: Typing 'zzz test item 999' shows 'Use "zzz test item 999"' option. Clicking it shows 'Category (optional)' dropdown. Category is optional — form saves without category selection.

BUG-155_master_item.description: Selecting 'Bread Or milk' (master item) does NOT show category dropdown. Category is auto-filled silently via handleItemSelect.

BUG-157.description: Left panel is w-72 (288px width confirmed). Category rows have minHeight:52px, height:52px, fontWeight:600 (semibold). 8 categories visible and clearly legible.
